facts.text: IU Kokomo provides the Kokomo Experience and You (KEY) program, offering undergraduate students four years of hands-on experiential learning and travel opportunities.

sources.title: Kokomo Experience and You: Indiana University Kokomo
sources.quote: The Kokomo Experience and You (KEY) program began to provide IU Kokomo students with unique, hands-on opportunities to explore the fields they want to enter after graduation.
